messages:
maria: heads up — product wants to start sunsetting the /v1/serve endpoint in ~8 weeks. asking for a minimal rollout plan we can drive from platform + console. any quick takes?
kevin: rough ask: staged traffic shift, quota mapping, and an opt-in console affordance for the grace period. also telemetry so we can see failed handshakes by tenant.
alex: +1. we should emit a routed_version metric (v1|v2|shim) and a header_mismatch counter. those are cheap and immediately useful.
jo: UX question — do we show customers a dismissible banner in console, or a per-route banner? per-route seems noisy for big tenants.
maria: product prefers per-project banner; ops liked tenant-level notices. console-team, thoughts?
console-team: per-project banner + a single health panel would be compromise. panel shows % traffic on v1, v2, and errors, with link to migration docs.
kevin: ok — for rollout steps: 1) emit metrics 2) enable a shadow probe that sends v2 header to a small % of traffic (no billable change) 3) enable hard switch for opt-in tenants 4) announce sunset + per-project banner 5) soft-quota smoothing for first 2 weeks
alex: about quotas: we need a deterministic mapping from v1 quota buckets to v2. v2 tokens calc differs for function calls. propose a mapping table and a simulator endpoint so tenants can preview cost delta.
jo: simulator endpoint is great. can we also provide a compare view in console that shows estimated monthly delta for current usage? :eyes:
console-team: yes — we'll add a "cost preview" card on migration panel. needs backend: /internal/simulate-v2-cost (auth required).
ops-sre: deploy considerations: avoid simultaneous tenant flips across regions. recommend region-based rollout windows and a global concurrency cap. we should surface stuck flips in SRE runbook.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: shadow-probe v1->v2 header emitter will be rolled to staging 2025-09-22T02:00Z and prod 2025-09-24T03:30Z if no blockers.
maria: telemetry alerts — set alert if failed handshakes > 0.5% for 5m and if v1 traffic > 90% after 2 weeks of opt-in. also capture top 10 tenants by error.
eke: (typo) meant kevin: We should tag migrations with migration_id so we can correlate logs across services.
alex: implementation note: instrumentation snippet for header we want: ```http
X-Client-Version: v2
X-Migration-Id: mig_2025_09_rollout_01
```
jo: edge case: some clients rely on implicit v1 headers. fallback behavior plan? we should allow a grace-mode where requests missing X-Client-Version are treated as v1 for 4 weeks, then start rejecting.
kevin: grace-mode toggle in console per-tenant with countdown > automated expiration. default ON for first two weeks.
ops-sre: add rollback hook: instant revert of header emitter + global toggle to re-enable shim. make sure can revert via runbook within 5 minutes.
console-team: copy request: short banner text + migration checklist items and link to simulate endpoint. we'll draft and ping legal for billing wording.
maria: next steps: action items — metrics (alex), shadow probe (kevin + ops-sre), simulator API (alex + console-team), console panel (console-team), rollout runbook (ops-sre). i'll coordinate with product for customer comms.
kevin: assigning tasks in ticket now. tagging folks: @alex @jo @ops-sre.
alex: quick question — do we want a telemetry tag for per-request latency delta between v1/v2? would help validate perf claims.
ops-sre: yes collect latency_diff_ms histogram with labels version_from/version_to. keep stdev and p50/p95.
maria: thanks all. will follow up with the prod announcement draft and migration timeline tomorrow. :thumbsup:
kevin: ack.
deploy-bot: note: probe rollout started in staging and passed basic smoke. will notify on prod deploy.
